comment: Staleness stamps for the TLA+ models. Checked by tools/formalfresh (go test ./tools/formalfresh),
which runs inside `make test` and therefore inside `make ci`. It does NOT run TLC — it asserts that
the document sections each model was verified against are byte-identical to what they were at the
recorded run. TLC itself is `cd docs/formal && ./run.sh`, ~32 min and a JVM, which is why it is not in CI.
role=subject: the model ENCODES this section's machine. A change can invalidate the runs. Re-run ./run.sh.
role=premise: the correspondence map CITES this section to justify an encoding or a stated omission.
A change can invalidate a recorded justification without touching a single run. Re-read the row.
FM-7 is this repo's evidence for what a never-re-derived justification costs.
knownStale marks a section that HAS changed, with the task that owns re-verifying it — the
`[SPEC EDIT OWED]` pattern: marked, not absorbed. It is not an exemption. It pins the digest it is
stale AGAINST, so it covers exactly one known delta: a further edit to the same section fails again,
and a marker whose section matches its stamp once more is itself an error.
To restamp after a real re-run: make formal-restamp MODEL=<name>

knownStale.note: TWO deltas now, and the marker is RE-PINNED rather than widened. (1) #224 rewrote §7.1 wholesale — the terminal rung is now a FUNDING step, the ladder re-enters the top-up, and the remedy is a durable episode recorded as specified-but-unmodelled. This is the section whose false parenthetical started #224. (2) #233 (v0.9.69, record §90) corrected the maintenance-bracket acceptance criterion to the fixed point at the LIQUIDATION notional, split R1b step 2's two bases, and added a refuse-to-size condition on a tier table failing continuity/contiguity. Delta (2) is sizing arithmetic over MONEY, which this model excludes by construction (see the companion's stated omissions), so it does not touch the correspondence map's §7.1 rows and the re-read #229 owes is unchanged in scope by it — recorded rather than absorbed, because 'it does not affect the model' is exactly the judgement this gate exists to make somebody write down.
